free_parameters.name: cands
free_parameters.why: Candidate window rows are not part of the witness. The target condition reads only strategy, so a small fixed set of realistic (layer, win_start, win_end, delta_ppl, channel_window) rows is enough to exercise the branch.

free_parameters.name: layer_order_map
free_parameters.why: Required argument of _order_candidates derived from the same five rows. It is unused on the random and unknown-strategy paths; the fixed mapping keeps the call real and deterministic.

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: The repository's own default --random_seed; fixing it makes the rng.shuffle below the target deterministic (RNG state does not affect which branch is taken).

execution.entry_reason: The declared official entry src/flexposit/api.py::quantize cannot reach the target: its plan_windows() always sorts by sensitivity and it contains no random/sweep strategy or call to _order_candidates (step 4 also reports call_chain_status not_found). The only real caller of _order_candidates is flexposit.mpq.channel_window.main() in sweep mode, which requires an argparse namespace, a HuggingFace checkpoint/tokenizer and the GPU/eval loop. The driver therefore calls the real _order_candidates directly, keeping the target function and its body unmodified; no stand-in is used at or before the target.
